conclusions: Field.multiplier has a precise existing generated meaning: state_role==plastic_multiplier, with legacy multiplier compatibility. Validation limits it to dimensionless zero-initial temporary scalar solve slots in residual models. The engine already uses it for zero-plastic-increment predictor/complementarity correction. It is a defensible algorithmic capability class, not a material family classifier.

For exact17 current definitions, proposed audited class is DP,MD1997,MCC,S-CLAY1 (four); thirteen other models retain historical702 directional FD. MD therefore keeps its current640 audited path. Rate laws cannot legally carry this residual-only role.

Implicit plasticity is NOT equivalent to a declared plastic multiplier: Mohr-Coulomb, Original Cam Clay and Tresca have no such slot and would use historical FD. This must be disclosed. A field name gamma, model.family, observables, apparent yielding or model IDs must never be substituted for the validated semantic role.

The dispatch is compatible with retaining the historical FD method for unselected laws and the already qualified predictor-class derivative method. Neither role semantics nor old-result parity mathematically proves derivative accuracy or guarantees convergence; rate/other implicit models do not acquire a common-partition guarantee.
